Chief_Complaint.content: Decreased hearing in the left ear

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Six weeks of progressive decreased hearing in the left ear
Intermittent tinnitus in the left ear
A few episodes of feeling a bit sick or dizzy, on and off
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: a few episodes feeling “a bit sick” or dizzy; on/off

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient reports that TV or music alleviates the ringing
Dizziness is mild and described as off-balance
Dizziness is not associated with nausea
Right ear seems fine per patient report
Prior similar episode about one year ago that lasted a few days
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Prior similar episode ~1 yr ago, lasted a few days

Assessment.content: Unilateral left hearing loss for six weeks with intermittent tinnitus and mild disequilibrium
Assessment.source_text: 1) Unilateral L hearing loss x6 wks with intermittent tinnitus and mild disequilibrium

Assessment.content: Differential diagnosis includes middle or inner ear issue including balance system involvement
Assessment.source_text: vs middle/inner ear issue incl balance system

Assessment.content: Otoscopy is needed to further evaluate the cause of symptoms

Plan_of_Care.content: Book face-to-face GP appointment in 4–5 days for otoscopy to assess for wax or physical blockage
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Book F2F GP appt in 4–5 days for otoscopy to assess for wax/physical blockage

Plan_of_Care.content: Administrative staff to arrange appointment and patient to call support line per instructions to schedule
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Admin to arrange; pt to call support line per instructions to schedule

Plan_of_Care.content: Provide tinnitus information leaflet link in visit notes for patient to read before appointment

Plan_of_Care.content: Educate patient to avoid cotton buds
If symptoms worsen or issues arise before the appointment, patient should book a repeat video consultation
